goal: Untangle Codebase & First-Principles Architecture Refactoring (ProviderContract Dispatchers, Generic Auto-Mount, ACL Consolidation, Strict Mode Safe Field Access, and Zero Redundancy)
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Run comprehensive untangle-codebase architectural analysis identifying hidden links, needless coupling, and special cases.
2. Author untangle-decision-log.md artifact documenting catalog of problems and first-principles redesign solutions.

3. Implement unified provider contract dispatchers in ProviderContract.ps1 (Get-CloudProviderFieldValue, Set-CloudCredentialAcl, Get-CloudProviderInfo, Test-CloudProviderBackendSession, Get-CloudProviderRcloneEnvironment, Remove-CloudProviderSession).
4. Refactor all providers (VpsProvider.ps1, ProtonDriveProvider.ps1, MegaProvider.ps1, S3Provider.ps1) to delegate ACL lockdowns and field access to ProviderContract.
5. Refactor VirtualDriveManager.ps1 and CloudTransferManager.ps1 to eliminate manual provider switching and use unified rclone environment dispatchers.
6. Refactor NSCloudDrive.ps1 to make startup auto-mount and account session removal provider-generic across all 6 providers.
7. Fix SettingsManager.ps1 ProviderDriveLetters deserialization to dynamically cover all registered cloud providers.
8. Recompile native x64 binary NSCloudDrive.exe v2.0.0.0 and update SHA-256 hash.
9. Run all 50 automated test suites with 100% pass rate (50 passed, 0 failed).
10. Maintain 1:1 granular commit and push protocol for every changed file.

decisions.decision: Consolidate duplicate Windows ACL lockdown functions across 6 providers into Set-CloudCredentialAcl in ProviderContract.ps1.
decisions.rationale: Eliminates ~200 lines of verbatim duplicate permission logic and establishes a single security enforcement boundary for DPAPI credential files.

decisions.decision: Introduce Get-CloudProviderFieldValue in ProviderContract.ps1 to replace 6 duplicate safe field access helper implementations.
decisions.rationale: Provides a single, strict-mode safe dictionary/property accessor that prevents PSInvalidOperationException without code duplication.

decisions.decision: Replace hardcoded provider switching in VirtualDriveManager.ps1, CloudTransferManager.ps1, and NSCloudDrive.ps1 with dynamic ProviderContract dispatchers.
decisions.rationale: Allows adding new cloud providers in the future without modifying core mounting, transfer, or UI lifecycle loops.

decisions.decision: Refactor NSCloudDrive.ps1 startup auto-mount loop to be provider-agnostic.
decisions.rationale: Ensures that VPS, Proton Drive, MEGA, and S3 / Metal accounts with AutoMount=true are mounted reliably on application launch.

reviewFindings.finding: Verified that all 50 automated test suites pass (exit code 0), 100% strict-mode compliance is preserved, and zero raw non-ASCII bytes exist in NSCloudDrive.ps1.

securityFindings.finding: Verified Set-CloudCredentialAcl protects all provider credentials under Windows DPAPI with exclusive User and SYSTEM SIDs.
